_comment: Gate L2 course on hp_1015_carved.pcd (map frame, m; heights above the local floor). Fly: tower (0.6 x 0.6 x 2.5 m) on the straight line (0.11,-4.46)->(-0.40,-9.00), 1.1 m clear of the racks' south end; pole_a on (-0.40,-9.00)->(-3.70,-9.60), the approach to the first landing; pole_b on (-8.50,-9.00)->(-6.50,-5.00). Drive: door, a 2.2 m wall across the west room at x=-5.50 from the south wall to y=-4.60 with a 0.90 m gap (y -9.45..-8.55), 1.8 m west of the east landing spot (-3.70,-9.60) so the robot can line up with it; the straight line from that spot to the drive goal (-8.50,-9.00) passes 0.08 m inside the south jamb (the frame cannot follow it), and crate (0.5 x 0.5 x 0.6 m) sits on that line past the door. History: g1/g2 had pole_a at (0.13,-3.20), mid-way in the 2.15 m corridor between the room wall (x -1.25) and the racks (x 0.9): SUPER routed west of it and stopped 0.35 m from the wall (robot_r 0.44), body clearance -0.05 m in g1. g3/g5 had the door at x=-4.50, 0.8 m from the landing spot: g3 clipped the south jamb (-0.07 m), g5 found no way to line up (no progress). g6 had the tower at (-0.15,-7.10), 0.5 m south of the racks' end: SUPER took the east squeeze round the racks' corner and stalled there (unreachable).
